risks.risk: Exact final plans not yet validated by installed native runtime
risks.mitigation: Mandatory fresh preview/diff, pinned runtime, no warnings/collisions and saved transaction preconditions before import

risks.risk: Installed module bytes may differ from corrected predecessor pin
risks.mitigation: Inspection command reports actual hashes; validate/apply refuse until reviewed contract is deliberately updated

risks.risk: Provider gates need registration before final integrator prerequisites finish
risks.mitigation: Seed optional real build hooks early or authoritatively insert a narrow prerequisite integration task; never accept no tests

risks.risk: Source/interface may change between producer qualification and consumption
risks.mitigation: Exact source/interface fingerprints and fresh task/checkpoint observation; revised capability receipts for affected changes

risks.risk: Schema/header/example placeholders mistaken for working execution
risks.mitigation: Real separately linked consumer, exact CTest inventories, independent oracle, backend assertion and no skip fallback

risks.risk: Toolbox work turns into a fitted biological experiment
risks.mitigation: Keep only synthetic correctness instruments and explicitly deferred research

risks.risk: Many agents oversubscribe memory or contaminate GPU timings
risks.mitigation: Live resource budget, first-class isolated lanes, actual lease and shared host lock

risks.risk: Both projects wait for each other to be final
risks.mitigation: CE M50 -> GH M60 -> CE M90 -> GH M90
